title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
没什么一见钟情，无非就是见色起意。在明白没有什么婚姻自主权的情况下，马寻当然希望找一个漂亮的，性格稍微好一点的妻子。马寻回到了皇宫，被通知直接回院子，他顿时大感不妙。李贞的院子里一屋子的熊孩子，朱樉、朱棡等人还好一点，朱棣、朱橚就是在逗李景隆。李景隆这小屁孩也不争气，非得跟着朱棣等人玩。“快快快，把旺财送回去。”马寻头大了，立刻对沐英说道，“给栓好、锁了门再过来。”沐英就忍着笑，结果朱樉跑了过来，“舅舅，我送旺财回去！”马寻立刻出言阻止，“你们几个都回去，让沐英送！快走！”李贞等人笑呵呵的看着，时间长了就可以看出来人心，马寻现在虽然还是保持着一定分寸，但是不会处处见外。几个跟屁虫开始‘声讨’了，一个个的都不满自家亲舅舅小气，连旺财都不愿意贡献出来给他们玩。马秀英打趣说道，“看样子是相中了？”李贞老怀开慰，“这就好，小弟眼界高，他能相中就好。”朱元璋不满意了，冷嘲热讽的说道，“穷讲究，自个儿一穷二白的，还想要寻个大户人家的娇小姐，怎么想的？”马秀英更加不高兴了，话里带刺的说道，“放牛娃都敢惦记地主家的小姐，俺家书香门第、诗书传家，怎么就配不上刘先生的闺女？”朱元璋偃旗息鼓，也就是徐达、汤和这些人不在京城，要不然就撕烂他们的嘴，四处透风的嘴、什么都说！朱标就开心的说道，“婉儿先说过我那小舅母颇有才情，为人也伶俐，肯定是舅舅的良配。”朱元璋顿时吹胡子瞪眼，“你和她什么时候又见过面？你们两个都说些什么？还要不要礼数了？”朱元璋骨子里还是有些封建老古板的特点，对一些事情看的比较重。马秀英更加不满意，“你瞎说什么？不知道的还以为咱家标儿和婉儿私定终身？管好你的嘴，传出去了婉儿如何做人？”李贞也提醒朱元璋说道，“重八，这话哪能说出来。你也是长辈了，身份又尊贵，话说出来容易让人多想。”马寻抓住机会落井下石，“大姐夫说的对，陛下是皇帝。我想无非是太子前几天接送她们出入宫的时候见过，路上说了几句话罢了。”朱元璋忽然笑了起来，“就俺是外人？姐夫，俺俩关系可更亲！哪能帮着他们数落俺！”“姐夫帮理不帮亲，再说了，俺是外人了？”马秀英笑着说道，“小弟明年成亲，须发长长一点，能戴冠了就成亲。”

马寻的头发不算短，都到了后脖颈了。只是放在如今这年代，那就是短了，不知道的是以为刚还俗没多久，或者是刚出狱呢。朱元璋也乐了起来，“还说没当和尚，去年才从庙里跑的！”马秀英拍了一下朱元璋，这段时间他们也没少派人前往福建一带，按照马寻先前说的一些情况，也去做了调查。基本上是复原了一些马太公、马寻的生活轨迹，只不过很多人对马太公没印象，对马寻倒是有些印象。“不算和尚，没度牒。”马寻坚持自己的看法，“再说了，我要是不剃头，我能从福建走回来，官府不得给我抓回去？”朱元璋和马秀英等人也明白马寻的意思，虽然天下初定，但是有些户籍制度也慢慢的在执行，一般百姓还真不能四处走动。不要说跨省了，跨县都难。又是开了两桌子，孩子一桌、大人一桌。“小弟，你先去军中挂个职。过些天给你安排点事情，你好立功。”朱元璋放下筷子说道，“明年你封公、成亲，事情一并办了。”马寻也不拒绝了，因为拒绝不了，“我打不了仗，怕死是一回事，我就怕本事不够损兵折将。”朱元璋赶紧说道，“不会让你打仗，都说了几回了！最多让你跟着保儿几个，保儿军功多，到时候让你些。你又是岳丈之子，封公没人能说什么！”朱标也跟着说道，“舅舅在军中也好，以后有二哥、三哥，还有舅舅，我手里就能控着兵权，不用担心那些骄兵悍将。”这么些年朱标私下里一直没改口，大哥就是堂兄朱文正，二哥就是李文忠，三哥是沐英。这三个也是看着他长大的，只不过现在前些年朱文正犯错被软禁在桐城抑郁而终，留下子嗣朱铁柱，现在也在皇宫，也是陪太子读书的角色。“姝宁性子温婉，有才情，最适合小弟。”马秀英笑着开口，对准弟媳很满意，“也找人合了八字，最是合适不过了。”马皇后说八字合适，那八字必然合适。朱标立刻凑趣，“娘，过些天儿子去替舅舅下聘！”现在轮到马寻被打趣了，不过他也习惯了，男大当婚女大当嫁，这不算什么。看向马秀英，马寻问道，“姐，我搬出去住，这事情能行吗？”马秀英虽然不太高兴，不过还是说道，“你真要成家，自然搬出去住。”“不急着搬出去，你姐和你外甥几个还要你看护。”朱元璋就更加着急，连忙阻止，“你先住宫里，你成亲了也住宫里。”
content_en:
It's not love at first sight, it's just love at first sight.Knowing that he has no autonomy in marriage, Ma Xun certainly hopes to find a beautiful wife with a slightly better personality.Ma Xun returned to the palace and was told to go directly to the courtyard. He suddenly felt something bad.There was a room full of naughty children in Li Zhen's yard. Zhu Xi, Zhu Fan and others were a bit better. Zhu Di and Zhu Xi were just teasing Li Jinglong.Li Jinglong, a little kid, didn't live up to expectations and had to play with Zhu Di and others."Quickly, hurry up, send Wangcai back." Ma Xun's head got bigger and he immediately said to Mu Ying, "Secure and lock the door before coming back." Mu Ying suppressed her laughter, but Zhu Xi ran over, "Uncle, I'll send Wangcai back!" Ma Xun immediately saidHe said to stop him, "You guys all go back and let Mu Ying see you off! Go quickly!" Li Zhen and others looked at it with smiles. Over time, you can see people's hearts. Although Ma Xun still maintains a certain sense of proportion now, he will not show off everywhere.Several followers began to 'denounce', and each one of them was dissatisfied that their uncle was stingy and was unwilling to contribute even his wealth to them.Ma Xiuying said jokingly, "It looks like you're in the right frame of mind?" Li Zhen Laohuai comforted, "That's good. My younger brother has a good vision. It'll be great if he can get it right." Zhu Yuanzhang was dissatisfied and said sarcastically, "I'm poor, I'm poor, and I still want to find a charming young lady from a rich family. What do you think?" Ma Xiuying was even more dissatisfied.He was happy, and said with a thorn in his words, "A cowherd boy dares to miss the lady of the landlord's family. My family has a scholarly family and an heirloom of poems and books. How come I am not worthy of Mr. Liu's daughter?" Zhu Yuanzhang died, that is, Xu Da, Tang and these people are not in the capital. Otherwise, they will tear their mouths open and talk about anything!Zhu Biao said happily, "Wan'er first said that my little aunt is quite talented and smart, and she must be a good match for my uncle." Zhu Yuanzhang suddenly blew his beard and glared, "When did you and her meet again? What did you two say? Do you still need to be polite?" Zhu Yuanzhang still has some old-fashioned feudal characteristics in his bones, and he takes some things seriously.Ma Xiuying was even more dissatisfied, "What are you talking about? Those who don't know, you think our Biao'er and Wan'er have a private life? Keep your mouth shut, how will Wan'er behave if word gets out?" Li Zhen also reminded Zhu Yuanzhang, "Chongba, how can you say this. You are also an elder, and your status is noble, and it is easy for people to think too much when you say it." Ma Xun seized the opportunity to add insult to injury, "The eldest brother-in-law is right, His Majesty is the emperor."I think it was just that the prince met them when he was escorting them to and from the palace a few days ago, and they just said a few words on the way."Zhu Yuanzhang suddenly laughed, "I'm an outsider, and we have a closer relationship!"How can you help them scold me?"My brother-in-law can't help with marriage. Besides, I'm an outsider."Ma Xiuying said with a smile, "My younger brother will get married next year, and his beard and hair will be longer, and he will be able to wear a crown."

Ma Xun's hair is not short, it reaches the back of his neck.It's just that in today's era, it's too short. I don't know if I just returned to secular life not long ago, or maybe I just got out of prison.Zhu Yuanzhang also became happy, "He said he didn't become a monk and just ran away from the temple last year!" Ma Xiuying patted Zhu Yuanzhang. During this period, they also sent people to the Fujian area to conduct investigations based on some of the situations Ma Xun had mentioned before.It basically restored some of the life trajectories of Ma Taigong and Ma Xun, but many people have no impression of Ma Taigong, but they have some impression of Ma Xun."It is not considered a monk, and there is no ultimatum." Ma Xun insisted on his opinion, "Besides, if I don't shave my head, can I walk back from Fujian and the government will not arrest me?" Zhu Yuanzhang, Ma Xiuying and others also understood what Ma Xun meant. Although the world was initially settled, some household registration systems were slowly being implemented, and ordinary people really couldn't move around.Not to mention crossing provinces, it is even difficult to cross counties.Two more tables were opened, one for children and one for adults."Little brother, you go and take a post in the army first. I will arrange something for you in a few days so that you can make meritorious service." Zhu Yuanzhang put down his chopsticks and said, "Next year you will be granted an official status and get married, and everything will be done together." Ma Xun refused, because he couldn't refuse, "I can't fight. It's one thing to be afraid of death, but I'm afraid that I don't have enough ability to lose the army." Zhu Yuanzhang said quickly, "I won't let you fight. I have told you several times! At most, I will let you go with me.I'll let you have more military achievements.You are the son of your father-in-law, and no one can say anything!" Zhu Biao also said, "It doesn't matter if my uncle is in the army. I will have the second brother, third brother, and uncle in my hands.I don't have to worry about those proud soldiers." Zhu Biao has not changed his mind in private over the years. The eldest brother is his cousin Zhu Wenzheng, the second brother is Li Wenzhong, and the third brother is Mu Ying.These three also watched him grow up, but now Zhu Wenzheng made a mistake a few years ago and was put under house arrest in Tongcheng and died of depression, leaving behind his heir Zhu Tiezhu, who is also in the palace now and is also studying with the prince."Shu Ning has a gentle temperament and is talented. She is the most suitable for my younger brother." Ma Xiuying said with a smile, very satisfied with her prospective sister-in-law, "I also found someone to match her horoscope. It is the most suitable." Queen Ma said that if the horoscope is suitable, then the horoscope must be suitable.Zhu Biao immediately joked, "Mom, my son will be hiring for his uncle in a few days!" Now it was Ma Xun's turn to be teased, but he was used to it. When men get married, women get married, so this is nothing.Looking at Ma Xiuying, Ma Xun asked, "Sister, is it possible for me to move out?" Although Ma Xiuying was not happy, she still said, "If you really want to get married, naturally move out." "There is no rush to move out, your sister and your nephews need you to take care of them." Zhu Yuanzhang became even more anxious and quickly stopped him, "You live in the palace first, and you will live in the palace when you get married."
